name: architecture
description: Design the target structure of software: clear boundaries, typed domain models, and testable flows. Use for substantial design work, hard-to-test code, domain modelling, module organisation, API and endpoint contract design, ports/adapters, functional core / imperative shell, explicit error handling, observability, or when code structure is fighting the change. Defines the target shape; the refactoring skill owns the migration path that moves existing code there safely.
